decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval: It is considered that the extension would not have an adverse effect on the neighbouring propertyies, taking into account the existing boundary walls and the relative height of the new extensions. The design is in keeping with the building and does not affect the setting of the neighbouring listed buildings. The scheme will preserve and enhance the character of Old Chiswick Conservation Area. The scheme complies with policies ENV-B.1.1., ENV-B.2.5., ENV-B.2.2 , H.4.1 and H.6.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 4 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
description: Extension of lower ground (cellar) to create playroom, erection of rear conservatory incorporating rear steps to access lower ground.
